claimant_name.quote: Nora Lind. On 11 March 2025 my handbag with my ticket and wallet was snatched at Brussels-Midi; while I was at the police station I missed my train to Amsterdam and bought a new ticket later. I claim for the missed train and my stolen belongings. Police report and booking attached.
